notes.title: 🩹 1.0.1 Patch Released!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
The game has just been updated to version 1.0.1, fixing some small visual errors and mainly fixing the save screen, meaning you can now once again load up your saves!

Here are the patch notes for the update:

Visuals

 ✨ Fixed small visual glitches with floating background decorations and mole trails moving away from the camera in one room



Bug Fixes

 💾 The save select screen now properly shows up all of your save files instead of three ghost identical saves
 💾 Loading an existing save won't reset that save slot back from the starting cutscene
 🕹 Holding down the Contextual Ability button won't stop you from executing said action

notes.title: 🩹 Demo version 0.7.4 Released!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
The demo for Faunamorph has just been updated to version 0.7.4, fixing lots of bugs and making small tweaks!

Here are the patch notes for the update:

Visuals

 ✨ Added particles to when projectiles hit something
 🗺️ Fixed Main Hub’s minimap showing a wrong room connection
 👾 Improved contrast between Sludgeswipe and background


Gameplay

 🏹 The velocity of ranged attacks has been increased
 🥊 The knockback caused by the player has been decreased


Bug Fixes

 💾 Save Station now enables the player’s input once again
 📺 Changing the resolution doesn’t spits out an error anymore


Other Updates

 🎥 Improved transitions between rooms
 💻 The developer's console has been accidentally added in the previous patch. It’s been removed now

notes.title: 🩹 Demo version 0.7.2 Released!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
The demo for Faunamorph has just been updated to version 0.7.2, fixing lots of bugs and making small tweaks!

Here are the patch notes for the update:

Visuals

 🎨 The Main Hub’s tilemap colors has been changed for easier diferentiation between it and the Security Sector.


Gameplay

 📐 The level design and enemy placement has been changed slightly for a better flow and movement
 🛡️ The Security Robot now has a smaller detection radius for the shield activation
 🧲 Player is no longer attracted to ground while high jumping on top of a platform
 🔧 A hard-lock near the Main Hub’s Save room has been resolved.


Bug Fixes

 🐞 Fixed bug where sometimes player spawned inside the ground
 🦏 Player don’t flip-flop when trying to start a Rhino Run close to a Rhino Breakable Wall
 🥶 The Octopus Tentacle ability no longer freezes the player in place
 💔 One of the Security Robots on the Main Hub sector is no longer immortal
 🖥️ The Game Over screen now properly works once more
 🔁 Player no longer stays in an infinite looping of dying and showing up the Game Over screen
 🐙 Player can no longer grab the Security Robot’s shield with the Octopus Tentacle
 📏 Pressing the Melee Attack button while on the Ability Unlock/Acquired screen does no longer change the resolution of the game


Other updates

 ⏯️ Main Menu now has only one button for playing the game

notes.title: 🩹 Demo version 0.7.1 Released!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
The demo for Faunamorph has just been updated to version 0.7.1, containing some visual tweaks and bug fixes!

Here are the patch notes for the update:

Visuals

 ⛔ Removed pipes in the foreground
 ✨ Decreased player footstep and jump particle’s transparency
 ⏳ Time of screen fade when transitioning between rooms has been reduced
 🔩 Extended pipes in the background next to the Armadillo Ball room.


Gameplay

 🔀 Vertical connections between rooms have their spawn point moved to prevent falling back down if you don’t reposition in time
 🛡 Security Robot now is invincible while it’s shield is open
 ⌨ Added support for navigation using the arrow keys inside menus


Bug Fixes

 💭 Fixed position of Feedback button in the main menu
 🌍 Fixed language option being reset
 🎮 Fixed input icons for Xbox and Nintendo Switch gamepad being swapped inside texts
 🎓 Fixed bug with tutorial prompt for Octopus Tentacle’s controls not displaying the correct icon


Other updates

 Removed prompt for changing sector being viewed inside the Map menu
 Added a Rhino Breakable Obstacle near the final room of the demo


Play the updated demo and don't forget to wishlist the game!!
